cantrip.label: Cantrip
cantrip.description: Dictation, saved recordings, recovery, and setup

cantrip.raw.label: Toggle raw dictation
cantrip.raw.description: Same action as Super+R; skips transcript cleanup

cantrip.clean.label: Toggle clean dictation
cantrip.clean.description: Same action as Super+Shift+R; requests configured cleanup

cantrip.cancel.label: Cancel without delivery
cantrip.cancel.description: Discard active capture, or cancel processing and keep recovery evidence

cantrip.recordings.label: Recordings and recovery
cantrip.recordings.description: Choose a saved take; copy its transcript, recover to clipboard, or forget its audio

cantrip.dismiss.label: Dismiss current notice
cantrip.dismiss.description: Hide the current notice without deleting any recording

cantrip.settings.label: Settings
cantrip.settings.description: Input, models, provider configuration, state labels, and reduced motion

cantrip.check.label: Check setup
cantrip.check.description: Native setup diagnosis, local model installation, and OS-keyring credentials
